problems_and_friction: No real friction: all expected pipeline files were present and well-formed. The main care points were merging into data.json without dropping the market-researcher's keys (handled by rewriting the full merged document and validating with a python json.load) and respecting PowerShell 5.1 syntax constraints. Being knowledge-only, residency and contract-term specifics had to be flagged as assumptions to verify rather than asserted facts.
context_understood: I was hop 2 of a 3-agent serial CRM-evaluation pipeline for Brightline (40-person Dublin ad agency), consuming the market-researcher's draft and producing the risk analysis (GDPR/residency, lock-in/exit, migration, hidden costs, support) plus a structured risk register for the final recommendation agent.
